c ******************* 786 **************************** c

Ref: "Photoionization of fine structure levels of Ne III"
     Sultana N. Nahar, New Astronomy 67, 97 - 102 (2019)

c **************************************************** c

Contents:
---------

 Ne III  : Total Photoionization Cross Sections of ground level
         (photoionized ion - in ground or in various excited levels)

          Process:  Ne III + h\nu ->  Ne IV + e


Explanation of photoionization cross sections of levels:
-------------------------------------------------------

Atomic levels are specified numerically.
Spectroscopic designation of each level is given in the energy file.

For each fine structure level, the follwoing set of atomic data are given:

line 1: zz=nuclear charge, nn=no of electrons in the residual ion,
    ntg=number of target/core excitations included in the wavefunction

Lines : List of core ion energies (in Ry relative to ground) in the wavefunction

Line : is, 2j, ip, ns -> is=0 (irrelevant), 2j = 2 times J value,
      ip(parity)=0 for even & 1 for odd, ns=energy position of the level in
      its symmetry, Jpi
   e.g. 0 1 0 1 -> j=1/2 e and it is the first level of symmetry j=1/2 e

Line : BE, ntot -> Binding energy (Ry), ntot=Number of photon energy points

Line : ac -> internal accuracy number (ignore ac)

Lines, ntot in total: E=photon energy(Ry), Epe=photoelectron energy (Ry),
     signd(Mb)=photoionization cross section ,
     sig(Mb)=photoionization cross section with radiation damping
